question: Should default skills such as `coding-agent` and `summarize` be installable by bare short name, or should OpenClaw require owner-qualified refs for those defaults?
rationale: Current source can implement either path, but choosing bare aliases versus owner-qualified official refs changes trust, compatibility, and user-facing setup semantics.

options.title: Use owner-qualified official defaults
options.body: Publish or identify official targets and update setup/docs/CLI defaults to install refs like `@openclaw/<slug>` instead of ambiguous bare slugs.

options.title: Add official bare-name aliases
options.body: Reserve and route selected default short names to official ClawHub rows while preserving ambiguity protection for all other duplicated slugs.

options.title: Keep short names unsupported
options.body: Treat this as support/docs fallout and direct users to search or owner-qualified install commands without adding a default alias contract.

recommendation.title: Use owner-qualified official defaults
recommendation.body: Publish or identify official targets and update setup/docs/CLI defaults to install refs like `@openclaw/<slug>` instead of ambiguous bare slugs.
